checks.claim: INSPIRE download represents registered freehold properties, not leasehold coverage.
INSPIRE describes indicative extent and position rather than exact legal boundary.
New files are published on the first Sunday of every month.
Downloads are partitioned by local authority.
A polygon on a local-authority boundary can appear in both local-authority files.
Title plan must be viewed together with the register.
Title plan shows general boundaries and usually not exact boundaries.
INSPIRE is suitable only after tenure/freehold eligibility is established; leasehold needs a different polygon source.
